worldcombat.skill.minimize.summary: Curls the body up small: incoming attacks are more likely to miss and evasiveness rises sharply, at the cost of taking far more from a much larger body stepping on you. The only member of its group that truly changes its size and the only one with a clear weakness; a bold shrink is harder to hit and easier to crush, a careful shrink lasts longer. The evasion stages come back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.use.0: Shrink before being surrounded so incoming attacks miss
worldcombat.skill.minimize.use.1: Survive under a large foe while watching for the stomp
worldcombat.skill.minimize.use.2: Buy a few safe seconds with a shrink window in a long trade
worldcombat.skill.minimize.description.0: Minimize raises Evasion by %1$s stages, giving incoming attacks a %2$s chance to miss.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.bold.on: Bold shrink: Evasion 3, harder to hit, but a much larger body hits for ×1.75 and the shrink is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.bold.off: Careful shrink: Evasion 2, a lower trample multiplier (×1.5) and a longer shrink; more avoidance against a smaller opening, each has its moment.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.description.1: The shrink lasts about %1$s; a body at least 1.3x your volume hits for ×%2$s.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.growth.0: At level %1$s the shrink lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.growth.1: At level %1$s the shrink reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.preference.bo: On: bold shrink, Evasion 3 and harder to hit, but a much larger body hits for ×1.75 and the shrink is shorter. Off: careful shrink, Evasion 2, trample ×1.5 and a longer shrink.
worldcombat.skill.minimize.preference.ai: Consider shrinking when a threat is within this distance; larger shrinks earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion respond instead of shrinking; larger gives up shrinking more often up close.
